case_document_attribution.sql:
UPDATE pattern_evidence SET case_id='N2'
WHERE case_id='N1' AND purpose='case_observation';

reviewed_claims_missing_official_evidenc.sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM claim c
WHERE c.review_state='reviewed' AND NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM claim_evidence ce JOIN evidence e USING(evidence_id)
  WHERE ce.claim_id=c.claim_id AND e.source_role IN('official_notice','official_guideline','official_form','application_portal'));
